candidates.name: ITEX
candidates.description: ITEX is a U.S.-based franchised business trade-exchange network. candidates.name: WIR Bank (CHW-System)
candidates.description: WIR Bank Genossenschaft runs the CHW system, a Swiss SME complementary-currency circuit founded in 1934. CHW is pegged 1:1 to the Swiss franc and circulates only among participating businesses. Participants set an acceptance rate, must make their full offer available to other participants, and must charge the same prices in CHW and CHF. The bank also offers CHW credit, a participant directory (CHWfinder), and a CHF 150-a-year SME package.
candidates.fees_notes: Published conditions valid from 21 October 2026: CHF 150 per year for the CHW SME package, plus a 2% network contribution in CHF on CHW amounts received. An interest-free immediate credit of 10,000 CHW is included for participants with good credit, subject to the bank’s rules. Amounts are in Swiss francs, not US dollars.
candidates.member_count_notes: The CHW-System page describes a network of tens of thousands of Swiss businesses ('zehntausenden Betrieben'). No exact current headcount was published on the pages checked.
candidates.evidence: Live bank site with a full description of the CHW SME circuit. General terms are dated 1 January 2026. Interest and fee conditions are dated 21 October 2026. Published address: Auberg 1, 4002 Basel. Advice centre phone 0800 947 947, weekdays 08:00–17:00. No public email was found on the pages checked.

candidates.name: RES
candidates.description: RES is a Belgian complementary-currency and modern barter circuit founded in 1996. It serves more than 2,000 businesses across sectors and also has a large consumer membership. Business members can take payment in RES points (with negotiable RES percentages for B2B trades) and spend those points with other participants. The network is a hybrid B2B/B2C circuit, not a purely business-only exchange, but it is a long-running commercial organized-trade system of the WIR/Sardex type.
candidates.fees_notes: The site says a freemium account can be opened at no opening or annual charge. Once a member receives RES customers, a 10% euro commission applies to the RES portion of the sale. Example published: a €100 sale with 50% RES incurs 10% of 50 RES, or €5.
candidates.member_count_notes: The site says more than 2,000 entrepreneurs and 15,000 consumers are active in the network.
candidates.evidence: Live site with exchange rules, fees, and member counts. News items include an 11 May 2026 member meeting in Wolvertem, a 10 June 2026 notice calling a 26 June 2026 general meeting, and an office/phone change effective 17 August 2025. Published contact: info@res.be, +32 15 422 776, Oudstrijderslaan 48 bus 1.1, 3140 Keerbergen, Belgium; RES cv BE 0456.589.985.
